items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: George Gaino plays very, very, pardon me, he plays very, very similar to the style that Caffrey played, the picking style.

ctx.x: He was. A couple of others. George Gaino plays very, very, pardon me, he plays very, very similar to the style that Caffrey played, the picking style. Yeah. And there was a number that we all loved to hear him play, was sitting in a corner. And he used to pick that beautifully. Now, he was what I might say, interested me in playing music, because when I would go to the dances, there's very little dancing I would do, I would listen to his playing. Now, as a bass player, as I said before, I played bass by a matter…
And then— Excuse me if you interrupt, I think I'd better ask. In regard to the old times when they played string bass, I've heard they used the bow more. Do you remember your father? Did he—
